bullets.text: Notion Capital's $130M Fund - **Notion Capital** aims to fill Europe's growth capital gap with a new $130 million fund.
Brave's AI Search Update - **Brave** enhances its search engine with a new feature for detailed answers to queries.
Opera's AI Browser Launch - **Opera** introduces its AI-centric Neon browser, inviting users to shape its future.
Charlie Javice Sentenced - **Charlie Javice**, founder of Frank, receives seven years for defrauding **JPMorgan Chase**.
AI Recruiter Alex Raises $17M - **Alex** secures $17 million to automate initial job interviews using AI.
DeepSeek's New AI Model - **DeepSeek** releases a model that cuts API costs in half for long-context operations.
California's AI Transparency Law - **California** enacts SB 53, requiring large AI firms to disclose safety protocols.
OpenAI's Shopping System - **OpenAI** introduces an in-chat shopping feature, reshaping online retail dynamics.
